meta.title: Roam Timeframe Table — Enhanced
meta.based_on: Original timeframe JSON (5 roam archetypes, 0:00-18:00) + online verification for Season 42
meta.how_to_use: Each role has steps aligned to real objective spawns. Use startSeconds/endSeconds for your in-game timer UI. Check 'objective' and 'checklist' for what to do, 'decision' for start fight vs run away, and 'dont' for the most common throw in that window. In solo queue, prioritize the checklist over forcing a fight — if your team is not in position, take vision + trade instead.

turtle.reward: 60/70/80 gold per hero for 1st/2nd/3rd Turtle + large EXP + 120s team shield. Last-hit: instant heal + self-repairing shield + adaptive damage.
turtle.note: First Turtle always spawns next to EXP lane. Countdown for next Turtle shows in-game within 120s after death. In Season 42 Healing Turtle variant, killing it summons a Turtle that pushes strongest lane + heals instead of shield.

lord.first_spawn_rule: Exactly 120s after last Turtle slain. Example: Turtle slain 7:45 -> Lord 9:45. If Turtle not slain by 8:00 and no damage for 5s, Lord replaces Turtle position after 5s, delayed up to 9:00.
lord.reward: Lord pushes weakest lane, buffs minion waves, charges turret for 30% Max HP True damage (8-18min), nearby allies deal +250 (+50% ATK +50% Magic +2.5% HP) Magic Damage every 2s.
lord.note: Lord is NOT fixed at 8:00 if you tap slain. Widget counts 2 min after last Turtle if you tap. If you never tap, widget falls back to 8:00.

lithowanderer.note: River crab. Small team reward + short river benefit.

roam_mechanics.buy_first: Buy Roam boots (600 gold, +40 MS, +18 Magic Defense) at 0:00. Do NOT delay it for another item — you lose Thriving gold/EXP.
roam_mechanics.devotion: For the first 8 minutes, you get only 30% gold from a minion/creep you take with no ally nearby. Leave waves and camps to laners/jungler.
roam_mechanics.thriving: If you are the lowest-gold ally, you gain passive gold + EXP every 5s: ~6 gold + 12 EXP before 8:00, ~8 gold + 16 EXP after 8:00 (capped). This is your farm. Stay lowest-gold on purpose.
roam_mechanics.blessing_unlock: Blessing unlocks after accumulating 1000 Gold from Thriving (usually around 4-5 min). Conceal is the only active blessing; others are passive.
roam_mechanics.vision_rule: MLBB has no wards. You are the ward. Face-check with HP, never alone at low HP, and always check the bush your carry is about to walk into first.
roam_mechanics.five_second_rule: Revealing an enemy grants gold/EXP. After an enemy disappears, wait ~5s and re-reveal for another proc — don't spam face-checks with no value.
roam_mechanics.solo_queue_note: Solo queue teams often expect you to babysit the Marksman. Don't. Protect marksman early, then follow the next fight. If your team won't group for Turtle/Lord, trade: take opposite buff, tower, or a safe pick instead of dying 1v4.

global_rules: Arrive 20-30s BEFORE Turtle/Lord spawns, not at spawn time.
Never start Lord with enemy jungler + Retribution alive and nearby.
Trade your life only for an objective or your carry's life.
Don't take last hits from carries — your income is assists + Thriving + reveals.
After a won fight, convert to tower or objective immediately. Don't chase into dark bush.
If you lose lanes, give up Turtle and take the opposite side (buff/tower) instead of forcing a losing fight.

compact_mode.goal: Widget must stay 2 rows tall in landscape. Collapsed shows callout only. Expanded shows full description, checklist, vision, decision, dont.
compact_mode.heroes_note: Heroes are pre-game only. Hide heroes in live view, show only when timer is 0 and expanded.
compact_mode.width_rule: Portrait 98% width, landscape 62% width so it does not cover the fight.

meta.beginner_friendly: Merged objective + description into one instruction per step. Tuned for Grandmaster to Epic: keep Ultimate, Retribution, Turtle, Lord. Explain peel, zone, engage, disengage, fog, CC, AoE in simple words.
meta.adaptive_height: Collapsed has no maxLines limit, height wraps to fit full description. No truncation.

roam_types_verified.note: Old 5 archetypes (Engage/Pickoff/Healer/Utility/Damage) were guide archetypes, not in-game labels. New 6 types use verified in-game Hero Specialty tags shown on hero card / filter + Roamer categories from wiki. Verified 2026-11-18.
roam_types_verified.source: Hero specialties page: Regen, Crowd Control, Charge, Initiator, Control, Support, Guard, etc. Roamer page: unofficially 4 categories Setter / Initiator / Utility-Healing / Damage.

mapping.crowd_control: Old Engage -> Crowd Control (Setter). AoE CC, controls many at once.
mapping.initiator: NEW. Initiator specialty. Starts fight on 1-2, comeback starter.
mapping.charge: Old Damage -> Charge. Dash fast into teamfight.
mapping.control: Old Pickoff -> Control. Guaranteed single-target disable / lock.
mapping.support: Old Utility -> Support + Guard. Save allies from certain death, shields/cleanse.
mapping.heal: Old Healer -> Heal / Regen. Regenerate HP, sustain heal.

roam_types_verified.not_a_roam_type: Damage, Finisher, Burst, Poke, Push, Chase, Magic Damage are also specialties but not roam playstyles - they are covered by Charge/Control. Heal in game = Regen specialty.

hero_pool_rule.rule: Tank or Support only AND in current Roam heroes list (Lane contains Roam, Nov 2026, patch 2.2.16). Removed if not Roam.
hero_pool_rule.current_roam_source: MLBB.io Nov 2026 hero list by Role & Lane + Fandom Roamer page: 34 heroes recommended as Roamer. Roamers are often associated with Supports or Tanks.

removed_this_turn_reason.Barats: Tank/Fighter - Exp Lane only in Nov 2026 list, not Roam. Was in Charge.
removed_this_turn_reason.Edith: Tank/Marksman - Exp Lane only in Nov 2026 list, not Roam. Was in Control.

hero_pool_rule.kept_note: Baxia (Jungle/Roam), Gatotkaca (Roam/Exp), Gloo (Roam/Exp) kept - they ARE in Roam list, Roam is one of their lanes. Kaja, Kalea, Mathilda kept - Support primary + Roam, even though secondary is Fighter/Assassin.
hero_pool_rule.counts: Crowd Control 6, Initiator 6, Charge 5, Control 4, Support 6, Heal 6 = 33 slots

blessings.name: Conceal
blessings.effect: Conceals you + nearby allies and grants ~40% extra Movement Speed for 5s, or until you deal/take damage. Breaks on damage.
blessings.cooldown: Active cooldown ~60s (in-game). Use to start a coordinated fight or to run away a losing one — not to walk into empty jungle.

blessings.name: Encourage
blessings.effect: Nearby allies (incl. self) gain +12 to +30 Physical Attack & Magic Power (scales with Thriving gold) and +15% Attack Speed. Recent rework also adds hybrid defense in team fights.

blessings.name: Favor
blessings.effect: Every 10s, your next heal/shield restores an extra 300-750 HP to the lowest-HP ally (incl. self) within range.

blessings.name: Dire Hit
blessings.effect: Every 30s, your damage to an enemy below 35% HP deals an extra ~12% of target's Max HP as hybrid damage. Finisher, not a poke tool.

roles.label: Crowd Control - Setter
roles.playstyle: AoE Crowd Control setter. Tank only. In-game specialty: Crowd Control - Capable of controlling multiple enemies at once. Your Ultimate is the AoE set-up - save it for Turtle/Lord.
battle_spells: Vengeance (vs burst / when you will be focused)
Petrify (second area skill stun if team lacks stun/slow)
roles.emblem: Tank Emblem — Concussive Blast or Focusing Mark. Prioritize HP + Hybrid Defense + Tenacity.
strengths: Wins Turtle/Lord fights with one good start fight
Best vision + walk alone into dark bush tank
weaknesses: Useless if you start fight without damage follow-up
Long cooldowns — if you miss Ultimate, run away
roles.win_condition: Land a mUltimatei-man stun/slow when your damage dealers are in range, then convert to Turtle/Lord/tower.
roles.lose_condition: Starting a fight alone, or using Conceal to walk into dark bush with no team behind you.

from_v1_to_v2: Fixed Turtle timing: first Turtle 2:00, respawn ~2 min, stops at 8:00 — original 110-150s window overlapped spawn and missed respawn logic
Fixed Lord timing: first Lord 8:00, Evolved Lord ~18:00 — original said 'Lord becomes available' vaguely at 480-600s without evolve note
Added outer turret shield end at 5:00, Lithowanderer at 0:45, jungler Lv4 window 1:35-1:45
Changed heroes from single string to structured array with archetype + S42 notes; added Marcel (S-tier), Carmilla, Kaja buff, Kalea buff, and clarified flex picks (Natalia, Hirara, Alice, Nana)
Added blessings as structured objects with exact effects, cooldowns, and unlock (1000g Thriving)
Added roam economy: Devotion 30% rule, Thriving 6g+12exp -> 8g+16exp per 5s, stay lowest gold
Added per-step phase, objective, checklist, vision, decision, dont — so table is usable as in-game timer UI
Added solo-queue adaptations: 5-second reveal rule, fake rotation note, don't babysit marksman, trade objectives when behind
Added battle spells + emblem per role
